channel.title: Ocean News & Technology Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: Strategic Marine Delivers First Two of Six Supa Swath Vessels to Mainprize Offshore Following Seawork Contract Signing
item.description: Strategic Marine has successfully delivered the first two Supa Swath vessels to Mainprize Offshore, marking a key milestone under the multi-vessel contract signed at Seawork in June 2024, Europe’s largest on-water commercial marine and workboat exhibition.

item.title: ClassNK Issues General Design Approval for Subsea Cable-Laying Vessel Developed by NYK Line
item.description: ClassNK has issued a General Design Approval (GDA) for the Subsea Cable-Laying Vessel developed by Nippon Yusen Kabushiki Kaisha (NYK Line). This approval verifies the vessel’s compliance with relevant rules at the detailed design level.

item.title: Dales Marine Services Launches Apprenticeship Recruitment Drive
item.description: Dales Marine Services has launched its 2026 apprenticeship recruitment program, marking Scottish Apprenticeship Week and reinforcing its commitment to developing the next generation of maritime engineers.

item.title: FET to Deliver Series of Work-Class ROVs to DOF
item.description: Forum Energy Technologies’ (FET) Subsea product line has secured a contract to provide four of its new generation work-class remotely operated vehicles (ROV), the XLX EVO III, to long-term client DOF.

item.title: Kongsberg Maritime, Seadrill, and Hanwha Drilling Forge Alliance to Pioneer Remote Dynamic Positioning Technology
item.description: Seadrill Limited (Seadrill), a premier offshore drilling contractor, Kongsberg Maritime AS (KM), a global technology leader, and Hanwha Drilling, a leading provider of offshore drilling services, announced a strategic alliance to develop the next generation of remote Dynamic Positioning (DP) technology in offshore drilling.

item.title: RS Aqua and Seasats Collaborate to Bring ASV to UK and Ireland Defense Market
item.description: RS Aqua announced a new strategic partnership with Seasats, a San Diego-based unmanned surface vehicle (USV) developer, to introduce their range of security platforms to the United Kingdom (UK) and Ireland defense market.

item.title: Autonomous ACUA Platform RS Aqua AI-Powered Acoustic Technology
item.description: This strategic agreement sets the framework for scaling long-endurance offshore missions, with uncrewed systems deploying persistent AI-enabled deep water acoustic sensors in open oceans. The partnership will accelerate the technical integration and operational development of clusters of RS Aqua’s NiKA ASW Profiling Floats with MARLIN AI acoustic processing systems, being deployed offshore by ACUA Ocean’s long-endurance, high-sea-state-capable USV PIONEER.

item.title: Subsea7 Awarded Contract Offshore Türkiye
item.description: Subsea7 announced the award of a large variation order by Turkish Petroleum Offshore Technology Center AS (TP-OTC) relating to the Sakarya field development in the Black Sea, offshore Türkiye.

item.title: Rheinmetall Completes NVL Takeover
item.description: Düsseldorf-based technology group Rheinmetall has completed the company takeover of NVL, the military part of the Lürssen Group. Following the announcement in September 2025 and the signing of the purchase contract in October 2025, Rheinmetall has now been given all antitrust approvals for the acquisition of Naval Vessels Lürssen (NVL B.V. & Co. item.title: Rheinmetall Investigates B-17 Aircraft Wreckage in the North Sea
item.description: Over a period of several weeks, Rheinmetall examined the wreckage of a US B-17 bomber from the Second World War in the German North Sea. Rheinmetall Project Solutions GmbH, a subsidiary of the Düsseldorf-based technology group, was commissioned by Amprion Offshore GmbH. The contract value is in the single-digit million-euro range.
